title: Narrow unfiltered memory listing SQL to the current project's heads
outcome: Unfiltered project-memory listing avoids scanning heads belonging to other projects or scopes while preserving current rows, ordering and pagination.
acceptance: The unfiltered candidate query uses the current project and project scope on memory_heads while retaining canonical binding validation
A meaningful SQL-work measurement shows that growing unrelated project/scope heads does not grow this project's page-selection work; returned rows and pagination remain unchanged
